hazards.title: Irreversible archive data loss
hazards.consequence: Authorized archive content cannot be recovered.
hazards.residual_risk: Storage/media failure and operator loss of all recovery copies remain; quantified operational analysis is pending.

hazards.title: Partially published or inconsistent state
hazards.consequence: Archive and journal disagree or expose a mixture not covered by the declared guarantee.
hazards.residual_risk: Filesystem and hardware durability behavior requires per-platform empirical validation.

hazards.title: Replication from wrong source or into wrong archive
hazards.consequence: Authentic but unauthorized content replaces the intended archive.
hazards.residual_risk: Compromise of all configured trust roots is not mitigated by protocol binding.

hazards.title: Mass deletion propagation
hazards.consequence: A large valid archive subset becomes unavailable or permanently lost.
hazards.residual_risk: Authorized malicious deletion remains possible; separate human/organizational controls are pending.

hazards.title: Corruption accepted as authentic content
hazards.consequence: Damaged or substituted data is published and reported valid.
hazards.residual_risk: Common cryptographic or compiler compromise remains until independent evidence exists.

hazards.title: False attestation of success
hazards.consequence: Operators discard recovery options based on an untrue completion result.
hazards.residual_risk: Underlying hardware can acknowledge persistence dishonestly; platform guarantee must state this limit.

hazards.title: Mutation outside assigned root or volume
hazards.consequence: Unrelated system or user data is modified.
hazards.residual_risk: Hostile kernel or compromised privileged launcher can confer a false root.

hazards.title: Long-term identity key compromise
hazards.consequence: An attacker impersonates an authorized node until revocation and recovery complete.
hazards.residual_risk: Endpoint compromise during legitimate key use remains; isolated signer design is pending.

hazards.title: Native platform capacity left unused
hazards.consequence: Sync and backup fail or thrash under realistic load while the host still has unused native capacity; operators are misled about platform support.
hazards.residual_risk: Hardware and filesystem features may be present but unstable; only stable, evidenced facilities are mandatory.
